author: omar.h@vendor.example
sql: SELECT SUBSTR(pan, 1, 8) || '****' || SUBSTR(pan, -4) AS pan, decline_code, COUNT(*) AS decline_count FROM card_events WHERE decline_code != 'none' AND LENGTH(pan) = 16 GROUP BY SUBSTR(pan, 1, 8) || '****' || SUBSTR(pan, -4), decline_code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
description: declines per truncated PAN (first 8 + last 4) — passes PCI-PAN, still a partial identifier
description_ar: الرفض لكل رقم بطاقة مقتطع (8 أولى + 4 أخيرة) — يجتاز PCI-PAN لكنه يبقى معرّفاً جزئياً
